service_aftersales_subtitle: Comprehensive maintenance, structural refurbishment, and genuine spares support.
service_aftersales_overview: Uptime is critical for fleet profitability. Our after-sales service team ensures that your tippers, trailers, and tankers remain in optimal condition throughout their life cycle. We offer body re-conditioning, hydraulic system check-ups, and structural crack repairs.
service_aftersales_h1: Scheduled preventative maintenance contracts for corporate fleets.
service_aftersales_h2: Availability of genuine tipping gears, hydraulic seals, valves, and trailer spares.
service_aftersales_h3: On-demand structural refurbishment to extend body service life.
service_aftersales_h4: Dedicated service engineers with deep product and chassis knowledge.
service_customdesign_subtitle: ARAI-compliant, 3D-engineered structural designs customised to your operational needs.
service_customdesign_overview: Every fleet has unique operating variables. Our design team uses modern 3D modelling and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to simulate load distributions and stresses. We tailor our fabrication to optimise payload, minimise dead weight, and ensure 100% compatibility with your chosen chassis model.
service_customdesign_h1: Turnkey drafting and design matching CMVR (Central Motor Vehicles Rules) norms.
service_customdesign_h2: Steel grade selection tailored to the abrasiveness and density of target cargo.
service_customdesign_h3: Rigid chassis modification and sub-frame optimisation for improved load distribution.
service_customdesign_h4: Full prototype and sample approval process before production commencement.
service_onsite_subtitle: On-site hydraulic repair, structural welding, and diagnostic services.
service_onsite_overview: To minimise downtime, we bring our expertise directly to your yard or work site. Our mobile service vans are equipped with welding machines, hydraulic testing rigs, and diagnostic tools to perform critical repairs on-site.
service_onsite_h1: Emergency mobile service support for major fleet breakdowns.
service_onsite_h2: On-site hydraulic cylinder inspection and seal replacement.
service_onsite_h3: Structural reinforcement and welding repairs by certified technicians.
service_onsite_h4: Fleet health checks and preventative maintenance diagnostic reports.
service_pickup_subtitle: Insured transit of chassis and finished vehicle bodies across India.
service_pickup_overview: We manage the entire logistics process, ensuring safe, insured transit from chassis delivery to vehicle handover. Our team of experienced transit drivers ensures RTO compliance and safe driving practices.
service_pickup_h1: Safe transit of chassis from OEM dealers to our fabrication facilities.
service_pickup_h2: Reliable doorstep delivery of fully built tippers, trailers, and tankers.
service_pickup_h3: Hassle-free documentation and temporary registration support.
service_pickup_h4: Transit insurance coverage for complete peace of mind.
